releases.notes:
What's new in this update:

News for hybrid trainings: We’ve added some functional exercises to prepare for your next HYROX competition. You can now track your hybrid trainings right inside Hevy. Enjoy.

Hevy Trainer just got more flexible: you can now change
the default rest timer, with shorter and longer options
to match how you train.

We've been polishing the app: more haptic feedback, a smoother dark mode experience, and a bunch of small Hevy details we think you'll appreciate.

Bug fixes to keep things running smoothly.

Also, keep your eyes open. There's a hidden Hevy logo
hiding somewhere on certain Apple devices. Most people
won't find it. Will you?

Keep lifting.
